short_description: Non-canonical FirstPersonEmbodiment prototype layered on the accepted CH9.6 character, clothing, Item Graph and ENet presentation stack.
purpose: Evaluate first-person hands, clothing-visible viewmodels, independent left/right grip UX and network-state projection without reopening or mutating the frozen CH9.6 checkpoint and without claiming item/network authority.
expected_outcome: A separate research lab can render two first-person hands, mirror the server-backed selected hotbar item, project upper clothing into first person, exercise local-only grab targets, and fail closed for canonical world-item grabbing until an explicit hand authority contract is authorized.
current_stage: FPE-R1 Fix5 — eliminate per-frame diagnostic and equipment reconciliation churn
progress_note: The dedicated detached FPE worktree reached a clean Fix4.1 focused pass on Windows Godot 4.7.1 stable double a13da4feb: class-cache preflight PASS, FirstPersonEmbodiment contract PASS 23 assertions, nonblocking hotbar adapter PASS 17 assertions, and graphical scene-load PASS 5 assertions. PLAY still exhibited severe continuous frame hitching in an otherwise trivial scene. Code review found two independent 60 Hz CPU/main-thread churn paths unrelated to GPU complexity. First, QuaterniusCharacterLab._physics_process calls the virtual _refresh_status every physics frame; in the CH9.6 inheritance chain this rebuilds CH6/CH7/CH8/CH9 diagnostics, calls ItemGraphEquipmentSource.get_snapshot through CH7 status, and calls network_server.get_report through CH9.6 status. Second, FPE itself called item_graph_equipment_source.get_snapshot every render frame, and that getter performs a full refresh with container validation, item/definition traversal, snapshot construction and fingerprints. Fix5 keeps accepted CH9.6 untouched and adds QuaterniusFpeCh9_6Host, a research-only subclass that throttles inherited diagnostic rebuilds to 500 ms while preserving gameplay/network behavior. FPE equipment/hotbar presentation is now dirty/event-driven from canonical projected_item_graph_updated instead of per-frame polling. Predicted hotbar selection no longer calls controller._refresh_ui, which rebuilt the full inventory/equipment screen; it refreshes only the persistent hotbar. FPE HUD now publishes local process avg/max milliseconds plus inherited HUD executed/skipped counters for operator evidence. The many untracked *.gd.uid sidecars seen in the detached worktree are generated by the Godot editor/class-cache scan and are not a runtime frame-lag root cause. Missing Male_Peasant.gltf remains a separate nonfatal external-asset fallback condition.
